In this role, you will lead high-expertise test programs (e.g., basic and advanced vibration, shock, sine sweeps), mentor junior engineering staff, oversee preventative maintenance, and collaborate cross-functionally with sales, scheduling, and management to align technical execution with strategic revenue goals. Salary: $110,000- $130,000/yr DOE Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Program Ownership Test Program Execution & Control: Assume end-to-end technical leadership for high-complexity dynamics test programs using Vibration Research (VR) control software and systems (e.g., basic and advanced sine sweeps, random vibration, shock testing) against strict customer requirements and industry standards. CAD & Fixture Design: Utilize SolidWorks to model test setups, review fixture designs, interpret schematics, and ensure proper mechanical interfacing between test articles and shaker systems. Pressurization Systems & Schematics: Oversee test setups involving pressurized systems, pneumatics, or fluid loops; interpret, review, and author complex piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs) and fluid/pressurization schematics for dynamic testing environments. Test Setup & Data Management: Oversee instrumentation design (accelerometers, strain gauges, pressure transducers, controllers), data acquisition setups, and standard server folder structures for secure document control. Data & Reporting Efficiency: Streamline data handoffs between lab technicians and the reporting team, maintaining a target 10-day report delivery lead time post-testing. Coordinate operations and admin workflows via laboratory management software (VLAB). CapEx & Facility Optimization: Work with facilities and management to evaluate, finalize, and execute Capital Expenditure (CapEx) plans, lab layout improvements, pressurized system upgrades, and equipment capital projects. Mentorship & Team Delegation Junior Engineer Development: Establish structured mentoring, deliver core training (lab safety, Vibration Research software/shaker fundamentals, instrumentation, pressure safety protocols, administrative processes), and systematically delegate routine test campaigns and customer communications. Technician Guidance: Oversee technician workflows, file compliance, safety procedures, and standard operating procedures across the dynamics lab. Operations, Scheduling & Strategic Alignment Preventative Maintenance (PM): Finalize, implement, and maintain comprehensive PM plans and daily checkout procedures for all dynamics shakers, controllers, pressure control hardware, and instrumentation. Lab Scheduling: Partner with scheduling and department leadership to develop weekly and monthly lab schedules to optimize testing throughput. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Department Managers, Sales, and Quoting teams to evaluate the incoming dynamics pipeline, support proposal development, and align operational goals with quarterly revenue targets. Skills / Qualifications Qualifications & Requirements Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in dynamics testing, environmental simulation, structural dynamics, or vibration lab operations. Software Proficiency: Hands-on proficiency with Vibration Research (VibrationVIEW) controller software for vibration and shock profile generation, setup, and control. Proficiency in SolidWorks for 3D CAD modeling, fixture evaluation, and reading/creating mechanical drawings. Technical Skills: In-depth knowledge of shaker systems, digital vibration controllers, standard accelerometer types, strain gauge installations, and pressure transducers/sensors. Strong technical proficiency in pressurization systems, fluid/pneumatic test setups, pressure safety standards, and reading/drafting system schematics (P&IDs). Proficiency in testing standards (e.g., MIL-STD-810, RTCA DO-160, launch vehicle/aerospace acceptance and qualification standards). Demonstrated track record in technical report writing, data review, and data auditing. Leadership Skills: Proven experience mentoring junior engineers or technical staff, delegating workflows, and leading cross-functional process improvements. Communication: Strong technical communication and presentation skills for interfacing with customers, sales teams, and senior management. Preferred Qualifications Experience with aerospace hardware qualification programs (e.g., commercial space / launch vehicle programs requiring high-pressure pneumatic/hydraulic testing during dynamic exposure). Advanced experience designing test fixtures and tooling in SolidWorks. Advanced experience working in a dynamics test lab Experience performing vibration and shock testing on a dual shaker system Company Overview Element is one of the fastest growing testing, inspection and certification businesses in the world. Globally we have more than 9,000 brilliant minds operating from 270 sites across 30 countries. Together we share an ambitious purpose to ‘Make tomorrow safer than today’. When failure in use is not an option, we help customers make certain that their products, materials, processes and services are safe, compliant and fit for purpose. From early R&D, through complex regulatory approvals and into production, our global laboratory network of scientists, engineers, and technologists support customers to achieve assurance over product quality, sustainable outcomes, and market access. While we are proud of our global reach, working at Element feels like being part of a smaller company. We empower you to take charge of your career, and reward excellence and integrity with growth and development. Industries across the world depend on our care, attention to detail and the absolute accuracy of our work. The role we have to play in creating a safer world is much bigger than our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer that recognizes diversity and inclusion as fundamental to our Vision of becoming “the world’s most trusted testing partner”. review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same. Job Description Your Role: We are seeking a skilled, customer-focused Support Engineer to join our team. This role involves providing operational and troubleshooting support for our Kubernetes-based platform services, including Port.io, and CI/CD DevSecOps framework called Argo. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of container orchestration, cloud-native application deployments using DevSecOps frameworks, and troubleshooting distributed systems. As a Support Engineer, you will work closely with developers, operations teams, and clients to ensure the stability, performance, and reliability of our platform services. Provide technical support for Kubernetes clusters, Port.io platform services, Argo DevSecOps platform, and resolving customer issues and ensuring system reliability. Monitor the health and performance of Kubernetes clusters, Port.io, and Medtronic’s Argo environments using tools like Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana. Investigate and troubleshoot issues related to networking, storage, security, and application deployments within Kubernetes. Collaborate with development and operations teams to improve platform stability and automate routine maintenance tasks. Help troubleshoot container images from teams experiencing challenges getting their containers to run correctly Manage and optimize Helm charts, Argo CD, Flux CD, YAML configurations, and other deployment artifacts. Using, configuring, and maintaining GitLab CI runners. Develop and maintain documentation for support processes, troubleshooting guides, and best practices. Ensure timely resolution of incidents and communicate status updates to stakeholders. Participate in an on-call rotation to provide 24/7 support coverage. Your Profile: Proven experience in managing and supporting Kubernetes clusters in production cloud and on-prem environments. Familiarity with Port.io (or similar platform services) and cloud-native technologies. Strong understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker. Proficiency in writing and debugging Helm charts and Kubernetes manifests. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation tools like Jenkins, ArgoCD, and GitLab CI. Experience with monitoring and logging tools like Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, or ELK stack. Strong troubleshooting skills in networking, Linux systems, and distributed systems. Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python) for automation. Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues. Ability to work collaboratively in a team and communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities. Excellent communication skills and a customer-first attitude. Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.
